evidence: Immutable expected extent is 0x5BF0..0x5FC0: 976 bytes and 244 instruction words, with an independent following function.
Caller 000018B4 invokes this initializer after 00004118 at module sites 0x19A8, 0x1A6C and 0x1B34. Constructor 00004118 requests 0x4F0 bytes at 0x4144.

Inspected shared layout family: 00004118, 00005BF0, 00005FC0, 00006900, 00008688, 00008988 and 00008A38. Shared partial definitions remain within the assigned source; other function bodies were unchanged.

Screen fields include indices at 0x3D0/0x3E0, panel pointer at 0x40C, attachment at 0x414, six four-float records at 0x420, and five pointers at 0x4DC. Panel row slots start at 0x40; row entries start at 0x3C and signed count is at 0x6C.

Entry dispatch pointer is at 0x28; selector fields are float +0x2A4 and word +0x2B0; initializer writes flags at +0x2B4. Virtual adjustments are signed halfwords +0x60/+0x80, with call slots +0x64/+0x84.
Callee 00003A28 reads entry+0x29C and child floats +0xDC/+0xE0/+0xE4, copying them to destination+0x60/+0x64/+0x68.
Original import call at module 0x18C in 00000058 passes the same six word arguments without preparing floating-point arguments. Live palette values in f12/f14 do not establish additional arguments.
Related initializer 0000C310 also uses an f0 full-scale quotient and f2 normalization divisor, with different branch and stack lifetimes.

A typed f32 pointer to four-component records recovers f2/f0/f12/f14 allocation. Assigning records and components in ascending order then reproduces every remaining numerator, quotient and scheduling instruction.

Normal and NON_MATCHING target C each compile to exactly the expected 976 bytes. INCLUDE_ASM is removed. All 138 previously exact functions remain exact; no unassigned function bytes changed; normal .text is unchanged.
make -j2 verify verify-blocks passes: the complete ROM is byte-identical to baserom and all six compressed-block checks pass. git diff --check and pinned reference checks pass.
All 12 original call sites and literal C callee expressions were validated against the recovered call graph.
Data alias reuses immutable expected D_807FE6E4 value zero. Accessor alias resolves to zero; its identity comes from original relocations at 0x5F4C/0x5F68. Alias values do not identify callees.
Experiments remain under build/orchestration-scratch/attempt6. Canonical episode creation and integration are left to the coordinator.
